instruction: Add an IPsec/Libreswan connection named myvpn to /etc/ipsec.conf
output:
echo 'conn myvpn
  left=192.168.1.1
  leftsubnet=10.0.0.0/24
  right=203.0.113.5
  rightsubnet=10.0.1.0/24
  authby=secret
  auto=start' | sudo tee -a /etc/ipsec.conf

output:

  ikelifetime=24h
  ike=aes256-sha2_256;modp2048
  esp=aes256-sha2_256
  left=192.168.1.1
  right=%any

  auto=add' | sudo tee -a /etc/ipsec.conf

output:
echo 'conn cert-vpn
  left=192.168.1.1
  leftcert=server.crt
  leftid=@vpn.example.com

instruction: Configure Libreswan to use %defaultroute for left
Add a virtual IP pool for Libreswan modeconfig
output:
echo 'conn pool-vpn
  left=192.168.1.1
  leftsubnet=0.0.0.0/0
  right=%any
  rightaddresspool=10.10.0.100-10.10.0.200
  modecfgdns=8.8.8.8
  auto=add' | sudo tee -a /etc/ipsec.conf

instruction: Enable Libreswan IPsec forwarding in sysctl
output: sudo sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=1 && sudo sysctl -w net.ipv6.conf.all.forwarding=1

instruction: Add a NAT-traversal (NAT-T) rule for Libreswan
output: sudo iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -s 10.10.0.0/24 -o eth0 -j MASQUERADE

instruction: Reload Libreswan configuration without restarting
output: sudo ipsec auto --rereadsecrets && sudo ipsec auto --replace myvpn

instruction: Add an IPsec connection with IKEv2 EAP authentication
output:
echo 'conn eap-vpn
  left=192.168.1.1
  leftcert=server.crt
  leftid=@vpn.example.com
  right=%any
  rightauth2=eap-tls
  auto=add' | sudo tee -a /etc/ipsec.conf

instruction: Set Libreswan authentication to RSA-SHA256
output:
echo 'conn rsa-vpn
  authby=rsasig
  leftrsasigkey=%cert
  rightrsasigkey=%cert
  auto=add' | sudo tee -a /etc/ipsec.conf
